# Text-only Feishu effect fixture

`channel-feishu-text-effects.sqlite` was generated by `DurableEffectLedger` from
commit `2f74c8989afd2da26a2b0b590c6581359d55fee3`, using its public constructor,
prepare and settle methods with the clock fixed to `1800000000000`.

It contains an accepted `weixin_text` record (`legacy-attempt`, `legacy-operation`,
account `old-bot`, target `owner@im.wechat`) and an unknown `feishu_text` record
(`feishu-attempt`, `feishu-operation`, account `feishu.account`, target `feishu.`
followed by 64 lowercase `a` characters). All identifiers are synthetic.

This intermediate schema supports Feishu text but excludes Feishu media. Tests
copy the closed database before opening it and verify that expansion retains
both original identities and outcomes while accepting the new media kind.
